title: Perioperative management in primary palatoplasty—an international survey
html: Orofacial clefts are common congenital defects. Primary palatoplasty aims to address the functional problems associated with the underlying deformity and is necessary for normal speech acquisition. International consensus on the perioperative management of primary cleft palate surgery is limited. A 34-question online survey was disseminated via email between June and September 2022, to identify differences and similarities in the perioperative management of children undergoing primary palatoplasty.
